'''0.25d''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that added support and decals for the upcoming Polish Teamplay Open Beta.

==Changelog==
===Equipment and weapons===
* Added new decals (flags and coats of arms)

===User Interface===
* Added Polish localization<noinclude>

===Bug Fixes===
* Fixed bug in use of antitoxins(the player became almost invulnerable)
* Fixed many bugs of game client installation
